task: Address PR #3505 round 2 adversarial review findings: validators must fail closed when inputs cannot be evaluated, never fabricate successful zero measurements.

events.content: Started from PR #3505 head b36edd54 in an isolated worktree to avoid unrelated dirty files in the main checkout.
Fixed persisted run loading to reject malformed fields, duplicate identities, bool-as-int values, and to normalize legacy v1 missing seed to 0.
Fixed model panel, model sweep, eval suite, rule activation, and optimizer adapters so unmeasured or malformed inputs exit non-zero.
Fixed UTF-8 replacement decoding in the four highest-volume non-eval subprocess files named by review.
Filed issue #3649 for the remaining captured-text subprocess readers outside the PR scope.
Validated with targeted pytest, ruff, review probes, and production-only fail-under-revert checks.
